services.name: ProductCatalog
services.purpose: Owns all product data including name, description, category, pricing, and images for the pet shop catalog

endpoints.description: List all products with optional filtering by category
Get a single product by ID
Create a new product
Update an existing product
Remove a product from the catalog

publishes.description: Emitted when a new product is added to the catalog
Emitted when a product's details or price change
Emitted when a product is removed from the catalog

services.name: Inventory
services.purpose: Owns stock levels per product, processes stock decrements on order placement, and raises low-stock alerts

endpoints.description: Get current stock level for a product
Manually adjust stock level for a product
List all products below reorder threshold

publishes.description: Emitted when stock level changes for a product
Emitted when a product's stock falls below the reorder threshold

accepts.description: Decrements stock for each product in the order
Restores stock for each product in a cancelled order

services.name: Customer
services.purpose: Owns customer accounts, addresses, preferences, and pet profiles for personalised shopping experiences

endpoints.description: Register a new customer account
Get a customer profile by ID
Update customer account details
Add a pet profile to a customer account
List all pet profiles for a customer
Update a pet profile
Remove a pet profile

publishes.description: Emitted when a new customer account is created

services.name: Order
services.purpose: Owns the full order lifecycle from basket through to fulfilment, orchestrating the payment and inventory saga

endpoints.description: Place a new order
Get order details and current status
List all orders for a customer
Cancel an order and trigger compensating transactions

publishes.description: Emitted when a customer places a new order, triggering the payment and inventory saga
Emitted when payment and inventory checks have both succeeded
Emitted when an order is cancelled, triggering compensating transactions
Emitted when an order has been fully dispatched

accepts.description: Confirms payment step of the saga, advances order to confirmed state
Triggers order cancellation and compensating transactions

services.name: StripeProvider
services.purpose: Wraps the Stripe payments API, exposing charge and refund operations to the ecosystem

endpoints.description: Create a charge against a customer payment method via Stripe
Issue a refund for a previous charge via Stripe

publishes.description: Emitted when a charge is successfully processed by Stripe
Emitted when a charge attempt is rejected by Stripe
Emitted when a refund is successfully processed by Stripe

services.name: Shipping
services.purpose: Owns shipment creation, fulfilment tracking, and delivery status for all customer orders

endpoints.description: Create a new shipment for a confirmed order
Get shipment details and current tracking status
Mark a shipment as dispatched
Mark a shipment as delivered

publishes.description: Emitted when a new shipment record is created for an order
Emitted when a shipment leaves the warehouse
Emitted when a shipment is confirmed as delivered

accepts.description: Triggers creation of a new shipment for the confirmed order

services.name: Notification
services.purpose: Reacts to domain events and delivers email and SMS notifications to customers, owning no domain data of its own

accepts.description: Sends order received confirmation to the customer
Sends order confirmed and payment success notification
Sends order cancellation notification to the customer
Sends payment failure notification to the customer
Sends dispatch notification with tracking details to the customer
Sends delivery confirmation to the customer
Sends internal alert to operations team for restocking
